question: Where and when was India’s first Senior National Archery Championship held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Delhi, 1973**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India's first Senior National Archery Championship** was held in **Delhi** in the year **1973**.
 
• This event marked the beginning of organized archery competitions at a national level in India.
 
• The championship has since become an annual event, attracting top archers from across the country.
 
• Archery in India has a rich history, and the establishment of the Senior National Archery Championship has contributed significantly to the sport's development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Archery is an ancient sport in India, with references dating back to the Vedic period.
 
• The **Archery Association of India (AAI)** was established in **1973** to promote and regulate the sport in the country.
 
• India has produced several internationally acclaimed archers who have represented the country in various global competitions, including the Olympics.
 
• The AAI conducts various national and international events to nurture and identify talent at the grassroots level.
